jobs.description:
Are you interested in quantitative risk modelling and knowledgeable of statistical, mathematical and econometrical models used in the financial industry? Are you an innovative thinker who likes to challenge the status quo and apply new analytical techniques to solve quantitative problems?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst to develop and maintain stress testing and provisioning models:
• develop and maintain stress testing and provisioning models in line with international regulatory and accounting standards requirements
• support with ongoing and new regulatory initiatives to manage our risk
• contribute to the development, refinement and implementation of risk models
• perform and document model performance and confirmation analysis
• communicate technical information to Senior Management, Risk Officers and Subject Matter Experts

jobs.title: APAC Sanctions Officer
jobs.description:
• Handle Sanctions-related advisory and escalations, and provide subject matter expertise (SME) on core risk areas to all relevant stakeholders in APAC across all Lines of Business
• Execute the team’s day-to-day activities, including assessments of customer relationships with nexus to sanctioned countries and/or persons, transaction- and securities escalations, reputational risk reviews, drafting and negotiation of sanctions related legal clauses in collaboration with General Counsel (Legal), analysis and commenting on new regulatory and internal requirements, etc
• Dealing with significant complex Sanctions issues, requiring detailed analysis and/or external legal advice/interaction with regulators etc
• Assist with the continued effective implementation and refinement of a robust Sanctions risk and controls framework in APAC, in consultation with the Global Sanctions team
• Produce and assist with maintenance of all relevant management information, including regular and accurate reporting to Management
• Participate in regional and global projects and working groups; assist with internal audits, compliance monitoring & testing reviews
• Deliver targeted Sanctions training to ensure employees in their areas of coverage receive training commensurate with the level of risk associated with their job responsibilities

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Private Funds Group
jobs.description:
Are you detail-oriented multitasker? Do you know how to make sure things run smoothly? Are you always one step ahead in knowing what comes next?

We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high level support to our senior bankers in PFG Global Banking business, based in New York. • provide administrative and organizational support including invoice & expense administration
• assist with staff engagement initiatives and ad-hoc admin duties

jobs.title: Card Processing Specialist
jobs.description:
As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by:

Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

jobs.description:
Build highly scalable, client facing platforms using Java, Spring Boot and Azure Cloud.

• Do you want to design and build enterprise scale, client facing applications using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud native technologies on Azure?
• Are you excited by distributed systems, high availability, and platforms used daily by clients across the globe?
• If you’re looking to start your career in a high energy, international agile environment that strongly encourages learning and professional growth, take your next career step with UBS.

As part of your team, you will

• •Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, first tier client facing applications within Wealth Management.
• •Develop cloud native services using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and modern engineering practices.
• •Work on distributed systems running on Azure Cloud and managed AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service).
• •Use Redis and other data technologies to build low latency, resilient platforms.
• •Collaborate closely with product owners, UX, and business stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
• •Apply Agile and DevOps principles, contributing across the full SDLC (design, development, testing, release, and support).
• •Write clean, testable code and contribute to TDD, code reviews, and architectural discussions.
• •Ensure solutions meet high standards for performance, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
• •Investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and help continuously improve platform stability.
• •Document solutions clearly and share knowledge within the team and wider engineering community.

Tech Graduate Program
• You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers:
• •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms.
• •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems.
• •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities.
• •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth.
• •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions.
• •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.

jobs.title: FX/MM Settlements Operations
jobs.description:
Are you interested in making an impact in the fast-paced world of foreign exchange? Join a team where your attention to detail and problem-solving skills play a valuable role in global financial markets. Find out how you can make an impact.
You will play a key role in ensuring accurate and timely processing of foreign exchange & money market transactions. In this role, you will support the business, manage post-trade processes, mitigate operational risk, and adhere to control frameworks while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Trade Settlement & Confirmation
• Ensure accurate and timely settlement of FX (spot, forward, swap, NDF, options) and MM transactions.
• Perform trade validation
• Manage confirmation processes—including paper, SWIFT, and electronic confirmations (e.g., FXAll, Mysis, GTSS)
• Resolve trade breaks and unmatched confirmations promptly.
2. Intraday Payment Processing
• Generate and release settlement payments (MT103/202) through the payment platforms.
• Monitor incoming/outgoing cash flows to ensure settlement obligations are met on value date.
• Coordinate with Reconciliation teams to investigate and resolve cash breaks.
3. Business & Stakeholder Interaction
• Liaise closely with front office, middle office, and clients regarding settlement queries.
• Collaborate with internal teams (Credit, Onboarding, Trade Capture) to resolve counterparty issues.
• Communicate proactively with counterparties, custodians, and settlement banks ensuring efficient processing.
4. Risk & Controls
• Identify, escalate, and mitigate settlement risk, operational risk, and market cut off risk.
• Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements related to reporting, confirmations, and recordkeeping.
• Regular preparation of risk reports.
5. Exception Management
• Investigate and resolve settlement discrepancies, fails, and breaks.
• Track and report settlement fails; identify root causes and drive long term resolutions.
• Manage CLS (Continuous Linked Settlement) trade submission, matching, and dispute resolution where applicable.
6. Process Improvement & Technology
• Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency within settlement workflows.
• Participate in system upgrades, UAT testing, and new product or market rollouts.
• Ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines and market cut offs.
• Strong problem solving and analytical abilities.
• Team oriented.

jobs.title: Internship in Regulatory Transaction Reporting Governance Team

titleByLocale.en: Internship in Regulatory Transaction Reporting Governance Team
titleByLocale.it: Tirocinio nel Team di Governance della Reporting delle Transazioni Regolatorie
titleByLocale.de: Internship in Regulatory Transaction Reporting Governance Team
titleByLocale.fr: Internship in Regulatory Transaction Reporting Governance Team

jobs.description:
Are you curious, detail-oriented and eager to learn how regulatory reporting works in a global investment bank? Do you enjoy working with data, processes and people across different teams?
We are looking for a Regulatory Transaction Reporting Governance Intern / Graduate Analyst to support our team in maintaining a strong control and governance framework across Regulatory Transaction Reporting. The role will provide exposure to key reporting obligations including MIFID II, EMIR, SFTR and FinfraG, as well as the opportunity to learn how change and operational governance is managed in practice.
In this role, you will support the team with activities such as:
- Assisting with Change and Operational Governance activities across Regulatory Transaction Reporting.
- Helping the team review and track changes that may impact regulatory reporting processes.
- Helping maintain trackers, action logs, process documentation and governance materials.
- Supporting the preparation of governance metrics and packs for operating meetings.
- Working with colleagues across locations to help deliver team priorities and governance objectives.
- Contributing ideas on how we can make our processes simpler, more efficient and more digital.

This is a 3-month internship.

jobs.title: Process and Quality Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you have a high client service orientation and a high risk awareness? Do you like working with colleagues across the organization and are you good with stakeholder management? We're looking for someone like that to:
– Act as an Onboarding & KYC Advisor to client advisor on onboarding and Periodic KYC Review (PKR) cases across the WM. Understand and articulate KYC requirements and work with client advisor through the onboarding and PKR processes.
– Be proactive and respond timely to market and business partner’s queries. Facilitate exceptional handling on risk-based approach, and coordinate with Business and Financial Crime / Compliance for signoff.
Review background check screening on the client, provide support on client profile with client advisor, and gather corroboration evidence material where available. Support client advisor to ensure regulatory compliance of submitted materials from client and client advisor themself.
– Handle Periodic KYC Review (PKR) case review from start to end, including client profile updates after consulting with client advisor. Further, perform KYC profile checking activities linked to client onboarding requests and ensure client KYC information consistency with PKR Quality Checks.
– Support client advisor on non-KYC aspects of PKR (i.e. file conversion for archival, raise additional name search request to middle office, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) review, PKR case manager management.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services.
• – Be-able to act as mentor for junior teammates and cascade management message in an effective and accurate manner
• – Be a trusted partner of market as well as other business partners.

jobs.title: Premises Operations & Key Project Manager

titleByLocale.it: Gestione delle Operazioni Locali e Responsabile del Progetto Chiave

jobs.description:
Are you solid as a rock when delivering large projects with set deadlines and budget? Are you passionate about corporate real estate portfolio strategy? Do you know how to manage and motivate teams? Are you interested in sustainability topics, from environmental management to LEED certifications? Do you like to analyze complex data?

This role includes assisting the team with strategic planning and management of the real estate portfolio for all UBS AUS/NZ offices, includes all AUS/NZ premises projects and related activities for UBS. For the first 18 months this role will assume the responsibility of Project Sponsor for the new UBS Sydney office project. This will require leadership of the project team taking responsibility to deliver the new Sydney office to the agreed time frame and budget allocated.

Major responsibilities would include:

Real Estate:
- Involvement with Real estate short and long term strategy, negotiation with Landlord directly or through real estate consultants for any lease related transaction
- Real estate planning, space planning / optimisation solutions for changing with business requirements
- Prepare recommendation papers and seek property and cost approvals for minor works projects from UBS management within designated areas of responsibility and in line with limits of delegation
- Managing and vetting the AUS/NZ Rental Invoices on a monthly basis to ensure the data is accurate to recommend for approval
- The ongoing development and issuing of monthly occupancy space utilisation reports
- Ensure AUS/NZ comply with Regional requirements relating to the supervision of 3rd Party Real Estate providers

Projects and Churn Management:
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for projects including office fit-outs (new and old), churns, office refurbishment and office stacking
- Work closely with Real Estate team locally and regionally (business management included) to provide Real Estate support that is consistent and coherent with the global framework in each of the UBS offices
- Generate RFP's for tenders with fair value recommendations working with the Procurement team
- Programme management of projects allowing successful planning in line with operating procedures for each phase of work, from start through to handover
- Monitor & proactively recommend workplace asset replacement / refurbishment in line with lifecycle / workplace conditions
- Prepare recommendation papers for business cases defining costs and benefit analysis
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for reporting on space allocation and premise vacancy to be charged back and issued to business departments
- Consistent application of Real Estate related tools

Site Operations:
- Interact effectively with UBS internal business partners and establish a balanced engagement model with each of them and work with them in a professional and proactive challenging approach to ensure a balance between businesses requests and Real Estate strategy and policies.
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ facilities operations on cost management, budget and forecasting
- Overall management of external Integrated Facilities Management service provider which includes SLA's to ensure KPI's are being achieved, monthly reporting, QBR reviews and performance management
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations in corporate real estate and operations for incident management and escalation, business continuity / contingency planning
- Establish and maintain strong and effective working relationships with all business department managers
- Develop and maintain effective lines of communication to create best in class service delivery to all business partners and project stakeholders
- Manage and monitor regular workplace and condition inspections, ensuring the work items are appropriately instructed Include regular interaction with key business unit contacts to ensure satisfaction
- Provide managerial guidance to the local delivery teams and resolve first level enquiries
- WH&S ongoing development and management

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about AI/ML, programming, and automation? Do you have technical expertise in design, software development, and modeling? Do you aspire to develop the next generation of AI business applications?

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with our data science and business teams to build state-of-the-art models, and perform exploratory analysis on new and existing data to identify, investigate, and solve challenges. You should be comfortable applying a variety of techniques to find the best results and capable of researching new methods to trial. You will work closely within a small team where collaboration is key to achieving our common goals.

• Collaborate with the business to assess opportunities for AI/data analytics technologies and maximize their value/impact for our clients.
• Support the design of AI/data analytics solution architecture and work with stakeholders to develop implementation roadmaps.
• Support AI/data analytics solution implementation and deployment.
• Develop, maintain, and deploy LLM, machine learning, and natural language processing pipelines and models with high performance, quality, and stability.
• Partner with the business to integrate AI and machine learning solutions across various strategic platforms. Models may span across a variety of domains, including but not limited to: LLM-based agentic AI architectures, natural language processing (e.g., document classification, named entity recognition, topic modeling, advanced and semantic information search, extraction), data analytics (predictive modeling, time-series analytics, pattern recognition, recommendation engines), computer vision (OCR), and voice recognition (speech-to-text).
• Research and build POCs for new and innovative AI solutions and technologies.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in generating new business? Are you strongly interested in the financial industry in particular investments? Are you tech- and data-savvy? Do you work accurately? We are looking for you!

As part of our RFP team, you’ll help respond to detailed client questionnaires that showcase our products, people, and investment strategies. These responses are key to winning new business and maintaining strong client relationships.

You’ll manage RFPs end-to-end, working with large datasets, automating repetitive tasks, and presenting insights clearly. A structured, analytical mindset and a willingness to learn are essential. While deep technical skills aren’t required, being comfortable with data analytics tools (see “Your Experience and Skills”) will help you deliver faster, more insightful responses.

The main tasks of your role are:
• To co-ordinate and produce accurate, timely RFPs, RFIs (Requests for Information) and DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) for prospect clients and existing clients according to internal brand/style guidelines and compliance regulations.
• To collaborate closely with portfolio managers, investment specialists and subject matter experts to improve RFP answers, ensure key messages are understood, and present our capabilities in the most compelling way possible.
• To ensure the RFP database is kept up-to-date and accurate, and quality continually improved
• To help the team identifying and implementing digital solutions

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you excited to work with a global team with diverse backgrounds and talents? Can you apply your technical skills to help quantify business risks? Do you enjoy the challenge of driving business impact through analytics and are looking for an opportunity to lead innovation?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to:

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.
• work collaboratively with stakeholders to assist in risk assessments and highlight high-risk areas for deep dives.
• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

jobs.title: Social Media Creative Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for an innovative Social Media Content Creator to join our corporate communications team. In this role, you will be responsible for crafting engaging social media content and producing high-quality videos that amplify our corporate messaging across our branded and C-Suite channels.
Our ideal candidate is a creative, detail-oriented, professional who is passionate about staying ahead of digital trends. An organized self-starter with a desire to grow in a corporate environment with senior visibility.
You will:
• Create, edit, and publish compelling social media posts across platforms. It includes but is not limited to: Campaign/idea pitching and briefing, story board creation, editing of videos, as well as post copywriting, infographic creation, graphic design.
• Develop short- and long-form serialized video content to enhance brand visibility.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to ensure messaging consistency.
• Report on performance and analyze data to optimize future content performance.
• Stay ahead of emerging social media tools and trends, providing period updates to stakeholder teams on future trends.

jobs.title: Intern in GRESC Sustainability
jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for safeguarding the environment? Do you want to be part of the bank’s journey to net zero operations? Do you have a keen eye for efficiency to shape a lean approach to our decarbonization program?

We’re looking for a candidate who will:
• Support our Global Lead for Energy Management to develop a robust energy management system aligned with ISO 50001, building consensus with regional teams.
• Assist site and project teams to create comprehensive energy management plans and conduct measurement and verification assessments to demonstrate initiative effectiveness.
• Contribute to the evaluation of environmental risk management within the bank’s risk management framework, ensuring well-designed and executed mitigation plans.
• Co-ordinate Energy Management Governance regional working groups focused on decarbonization and meter data coverage of utility operations, progressing activities in line with agreed timelines and milestones.
• Analyse and calculate utility consumption to assist regional teams with consumption forecasts and renewable energy certificate purchases.

You will be directly involved in day-to-day project operations, gaining business-specific exposure from professionals with different areas of expertise within Group Real Estate and Supply Chain (GRESC). You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your internship. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this internship is for you.
